errors.description: The coin pocket is still stitched closed on all four sides, so it reads as a sealed patch of cloth rather than a pocket. The illustration's outline is a U - bottom edge and two vertical sides only, with an OPEN top which is the entry. Three attempts have each produced a fully closed rectangle.
errors.expected: U outline: horizontal bottom edge, two short vertical sides, no stitching across the top; the top edge is the finished, faintly open coin-pocket entry.
errors.actual: A rectangle with an identical inset stitch line on all four edges, including the top.
errors.correction: Stitch only the bottom and the two sides. Leave the top edge as an open, lightly relaxed pocket mouth with a whisper of pocketing visible inside.

errors.description: The coin pocket grew from attempt 2 but is still slightly under-sized and the wrong aspect: it spans about 65% of the left pocket bag's width where the drawing shows about 75%, and it is a touch taller than wide where the drawing is about 1.3 times wider than tall.
errors.expected: About three quarters of the bag width, and clearly wider than tall.
errors.actual: About two thirds of the bag width, and slightly taller than wide.
errors.correction: Widen it and shorten its height so it is unmistakably a wide, shallow coin pocket.

errors.description: The frame still carries a band of bare trouser leg below the pocket bags.
errors.expected: Bottom edge just below the lowest point of the pocket bags.
errors.actual: Leg continues to the bottom edge of the frame.
errors.correction: Crop the bottom edge just under the pocket bags.

lockedFeatures: flat overhead interior construction view of the trouser front laid open, no model, no torso, no hands
both pocket bags fully in frame, one to the left and one to the right of the centre fly, so the left/right distinction reads
the coin pocket on the LEFT pocket bag only; the right pocket bag completely plain
the coin pocket low on the bag, its bottom edge just above the bag's curved lower edge
centre fly running vertically down the middle
everything in one quiet mid-grey wool with visible weave; no contrast waistband or facing, no buttons or studs, no exterior flap pockets
no text, numbers, arrows or annotation anywhere in frame
no red or highlighter colour anywhere in the cloth
notes: Attempt 3 of 3. Face of the garment, both pocket bags, the left-side placement and the invented-detail problems are all fixed and stable. The one unresolved fault is that the model will not leave the top of the coin pocket open - it renders a closed four-sided patch every time, so the pocket has no entry. Retry budget spent; not eligible for the 95 waiver because a Major finding remains.
